title: Lap Attack: the original solo race type
summary: Lap Attack is now an Event row option on every race course, for one player and split screen. It has no CPUs, Laps and CPU riders read N/A, and there is no finish. Beating your best lap shows "New Lap Attack Lap Set!" (original 00216750). Ride links accept event=lapattack.
details: Your best judged lap is recorded and replayed on later laps as a ghost, but the ghost is not drawn on track yet (#480). Evidence from the exact USA v2.00 build is in research/RACING.md under Lap Attack event type; for example the original ghost rider uses the same quad at opacity 0.4. PR #481 (part of #451), live at e59ee43. Verification: test_engine_race_lap_attack passes on the host and against furyremastered.com; the practice, duel, ride_link, race and menu_flows browser tests pass.
limitation: Ghost is recorded but not drawn (#480). In split screen only player 1 records a ghost. The lap-time list is clipped at the right edge (#482).
caption: Lap 3 on Sausalito showing New Lap Attack Lap Set!; no ghost is drawn yet (#480).
